invite.title: Invitation
invite.introWorkspace: {inviter} invited you to the {organization} organization and the “{workspace}” workspace.

status.Expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send it again.
status.Accepted: This invitation has already been accepted.
status.Revoked: This invitation was revoked or replaced by a new one. Use the latest invitation in your email.

invite.wrongAccount: You are currently signed in as {current}. To accept the invitation, sign out and sign in as {invited}.

oauthCallback.failed: The sign-in details could not be delivered to the Apivator window. Close this window and try again.
oauthCallback.done: Sign-in complete. You can close this window if it does not close by itself.

org.name: Organization name
org.languageHint: Language of invitation and notification emails and the starting language of new members
org.namePlaceholder: Name of your company or team

empty.title: Work with your team
empty.body: Create an organization, invite people by email and share collections in team workspaces. Your personal workspace <lock/> stays private to you.

inviteForm.label: Invite
inviteForm.title: Invite people
inviteForm.hint: The invitation link is valid for 7 days. Admins can access all team workspaces and manage people.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.label: Transfer
transfer.body: {name} becomes the owner of the organization and you remain an admin. Only the new owner can undo this.

revokeSessions.title: Sign out of all sessions
revokeSessions.label: Sign out sessions
revokeSessions.body: {name} will be signed out on all devices and must sign in again. They are notified by email and it is recorded in their security history.
revokeSessions.done: All sessions for {name} were signed out.

passwordReset.title: Send password reset link
passwordReset.label: Send
passwordReset.body: A password reset link will be sent to {email}. Their current password stays valid until they set a new one.

remove.title: Remove from organization
remove.label: Remove
remove.body: {name} loses access to all workspaces and teams of this organization.

leave.title: Leave organization
leave.label: Leave
leave.body: You lose access to the workspaces and teams in {name}. You need to be invited again to return.

teams.intro: Teams group people. When you add a team to a workspace, all of its members get access; anyone who joins the team gets access automatically.

remove.title: Delete team
remove.label: Delete
remove.body: Workspace access granted through “{name}” is removed. People stay in the organization.

security.requireHint: Members who have not enabled it cannot see the organization’s workspaces (including API keys) until they set it up; they see a warning in the app.
security.enableFirst: Before requiring it, enable two-step verification on your own account: <link>Account settings › Security</link>
security.note: To sign a member out of all sessions or send them a password reset link, use the menu next to their name in the Members tab. These actions are recorded in the member’s security history under your name.

workspaces.empty: You have no accessible workspaces. Ask an admin to add you.
